current_prompt.body:
CREATE three independent user stories derived from the combined request.
COMBINED REQUEST:
(1) As a user, I want to search for products by name so that I can find what I'm looking for quickly.
(2) As a user, I want the system to show me my recent orders and recommend similar products based on my purchase history.
(3) As a user, I want to see real-time inventory levels from all warehouse locations when I click on a product and be able to reserve items for up to 24 hours.

current_plan.body:
PARSE the combined request text
EXTRACT each functional requirement clause
MAP each clause to the user story template "As a user, I want ... so that ..."
GENERATE three independent user stories from the mapped clauses
EMIT the three independent user stories
